risks.title: Fraud and financial loss
risks.summary: The company incurred a financial loss of $2.7 million due to a wire fraud incident in fiscal 2024. Although recovery efforts are ongoing and investigation expenses have been incurred, this incident highlights a vulnerability to financial fraud.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in the risk factors (Item 1A), the language is direct regarding a complex fraud and a net loss of $2.7M after recovery. While some funds were recovered, fraud risk remains a major concern for financial security. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: International contract dispute
risks.summary: A UK subsidiary is involved in a major dispute over a foreign project, with a cumulative contractual loss of $13.4 million, unresolved billable receivables, and unsettled contract variations.
risks.score_rationale: Described in detail in Item 7, this dispute involves a UK subsidiary with an estimated loss of $13.4M recognized progressively (3.4M in fiscal 2025, remainder in fiscal 2024). Unresolved billable receivables, contract variations, and claims indicate significant complexity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on the energy market
risks.summary: A significant portion of the $2.9B project backlog comes from the energy sector (Power segment), making the company vulnerable to regulatory fluctuations, project financing challenges, and interconnection delays.
risks.score_rationale: Item 7 details that the project backlog is largely composed of Power segment projects. Heavy concentration in the energy sector may amplify sector-specific risks related to regulatory and financing cycles. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Project delay risk
risks.summary: Projects depend on customer schedules and regulatory approvals, which can lead to unforeseen delays affecting revenues, delivery timelines, and project profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Item 7 explicitly states that project start dates are controlled by owners and delays may occur. A specific example is given for the Midwest solar project, which experienced regulatory delays. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Contract loss management
risks.summary: The company has recorded significant losses on contracts, including a $13.4 million international project, highlighting the risk of cost overruns or complications in managing complex contracts.
risks.score_rationale: Item 7 mentions a $13.4M contractual loss on a foreign project, recognized progressively. This indicates an ongoing risk of poor estimation or cost overruns on complex international contracts. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Electricity market volatility and interconnection delays
risks.summary: The power generation sector faces structural challenges including equipment supply constraints, grid interconnection delays, and evolving regulatory requirements that may impact project timelines and economic viability.
risks.score_rationale: Item 7 details energy market challenges: equipment supply constraints, interconnection delays, regulatory changes, and financing considerations. These factors can affect project development schedules and viability. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: AGX does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The company focuses on engineering and construction of energy infrastructure.
